  "course_description": "This course examines modern AI-native software development, focusing on how developers collaborate with coding agents. Designed for advanced undergraduate students, it covers defining intent, context engineering, structuring development workflows, and coordinating AI tools. Rather than serving as a general introduction to machine learning, a traditional programming course, or a theoretical study of large language models, it emphasizes practical, workflow-oriented software engineering. Students will learn to configure AI coding tools using Model Context Protocol servers, construct executable specifications from natural language requirements, and analyze iterative agentic debugging loops. They will also evaluate automated testing, deployment, and reliability metrics for agent-generated artifacts, culminating in the delivery of an end-to-end software application.
